parameters.host_memory_policy: No host KV offload or dedicated host-RAM reservation
parameters.comparison_scope: Matched27B tokenizer/workload; TP2/C16/query4096/context256K/KV24.25GiB; native hybrid versus BetterScale FULL. Not a35B-token replay or isolated small-fish ablation
parameters.functional_scope: 24/24 exact long/cold/warm/concurrent retrievals; not general quality certification

runs.cleanup: Server exit0, continuous selected-device foreign-owner guard exit0, complete30s idle release

client.routing_policy: lane modulo DP size via X-data-parallel-rank
client.cache_policy: unique salt per session play; reused within session; no cross-session reuse
client.window_policy: cold-start fixed duration; count streamed tokens in window; drain in-flight only

capacity_validation.scope: Sampled engine-active occupancy across all DP ranks; bounded workload only, not C full-256K requests

partition_validation.scope: loaded weight geometry and expert-map coverage, not semantic qualification

runs.scope: Metric-only public extract; original token IDs, source capsules and guarded admission/release evidence retained by measurement owner
